candidates.mechanism: An SSE disconnect closes streams but leaves the session ID in the in-process writer registry, so a later POST to that stale ID is accepted instead of rejected.
candidates.target_behavior: After disconnect, the session entry is absent and a POST using the old session ID returns HTTP 404 rather than entering a closed stream.
verification_method: Checkout the fixed base SHA and freeze a deterministic connect-disconnect-POST regression oracle.
Confirm the oracle fails before repair.
Apply the minimal registry cleanup, run the focused test, and confirm the old session is rejected.
Run the adjacent SSE test subset and archive red/green evidence.

existing_solution.note: The merged repair is one registry pop plus a regression test. The PR explicitly corrects its original server-reload explanation; that rejected premise is evidence, not an instruction.

limitations: Historical replay only; the correct repair is public and cannot measure blind diagnosis.

No independent transfer target or fresh artifact isolation has been established.

candidates.mechanism: SSE, StreamableHTTP, and WebSocket client transports close only part of paired anyio memory streams, so garbage collection emits ResourceWarning in unrelated later tests.
candidates.target_behavior: All four stream ends close on connection-error and normal-exit paths, and forced garbage collection emits no MemoryObject stream ResourceWarning.
verification_method: Checkout the fixed base SHA and freeze the three transport cleanup tests around sys.unraisablehook and forced garbage collection.
Confirm at least the affected transport paths fail before repair.
Apply minimal close/finally changes and confirm focused red-to-green behavior.

candidates.mechanism: When a transport reports an exception and then closes, the server tries to send an error log notification through the failing transport, racing teardown and raising ClosedResourceError.
candidates.target_behavior: The server logs transport exceptions locally, writes no notification to a broken transport, and exits cleanly without ClosedResourceError while preserving raise_exceptions behavior.
verification_method: Checkout the fixed base SHA and freeze the real anyio-stream integration regression.
Confirm the pre-repair path reproduces the teardown ClosedResourceError.
Apply the minimal removal of the transport write and confirm clean exit plus zero outbound message.
Run focused low-level server/session tests and archive red/green evidence.
